# Fixtures for `test_reconcile_domostats.py`

Real slices, not invented data. Everything here was cut from the actual article and the
actual generated manifest so the tests exercise the shapes the reconciler really meets.

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `article-baseline.mdx` | 14 sections of `s/article/360043433813.mdx`, chosen to cover every structural anomaly the rewriter must survive. **Converged**: reconciling it against `manifest-baseline.json` must produce zero diff. |
| `manifest-baseline.json` | The matching 14 reports from `domostats-schema.json` (format v2), generated by `./gradlew generateSchemaManifest` against `domostats@2cb964ff` (master). Gating is sanitized at the source: kinds only, no customer or environment names. |
| `article-rolegrants-before.mdx` | `article-baseline.mdx` with the last three Role Grants rows removed, standing in for the article before the connector gained those columns. |
| `manifest-rolegrants.json` | `manifest-baseline.json` with Role Grants replaced by the six-column version generated against `domostats@1bd786e7` (`users/bryce-cindrich/DOMO-492939-role-grants-columns`). |

The synthetic-change test reconciles `article-rolegrants-before.mdx` against
`manifest-rolegrants.json` and asserts the result equals `article-baseline.mdx`
byte-for-byte. `article-baseline.mdx` carries PR #414's hand-written Role Grants table, so
that assertion is "the reconciler reproduces what a human wrote, from the Java schema
alone."

## Sections covered, and why each is here

| Section | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `Accounts` | plain header, ordinary two-column table |
| `Activity Log` | bold header, escaped underscores in field names (`\_BATCH_ID\_`) |
| `Beast Modes used in Beast Modes` | prose **before** the table |
| `Certified Content` | prose **after** the table |
| `Domo Goals \| Goals` | curated block, `<Note>` plus prose, literal pipe in the heading |
| `Domo Goals \| Goal Owners` | curated block member (insertion must append, not sort) |
| `PDP - Column Policies`, `PDP - Row Policies` | the second curated block |
| `People` | bold header plus prose, and a row order that differs from schema order |
| `Role Grants` | the synthetic-change target; all six rows differ raw and match normalized |
| `Roles` | plain control section for removal and duplicate-column tests |
| `Task Center` | empty header row with the real header as the first data row |
| `Upgrade Path Conversions` | no table at all (schema built at run time) |
| `Usage Metrics` | feature-switch `<Note>` that must never be reworded |

## Regenerating

Point the reconciler at a freshly generated manifest and re-cut the slices only when the
article's structure changes in a way the current fixtures do not represent. Regenerate the
manifest with:

```bash
cd path/to/domostats && ./gradlew generateSchemaManifest
```

After re-cutting `article-baseline.mdx`, converge it once (run the reconciler against
`manifest-baseline.json` without `--dry-run`) so the golden no-op test stays a true no-op,
then re-derive `article-rolegrants-before.mdx` from it.

`TestReportOnly.test_no_customer_or_environment_identifier_reaches_the_report` scans
`manifest-baseline.json` for customer and environment identifiers, so a regenerated
fixture that reintroduces them fails the suite rather than reaching a public PR.
